# RecDiffy.NET profiles: matching passes

> A path takes the rows its route accepts and matches them with its passes, in order of preference: the earliest pass that can commit a match takes the rows. Pair passes match one row to one row on a key; match.groupSum matches several rows on one side to one row on the other when the conserved fields sum exactly. A key with more than one row on a side is ambiguous, and RecDiffy doesn't guess. Up: https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/profiles/llms.txt

## Reference

- [Paths: routes, passes and comparison](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/paths-routes-passes-and-comparison.md): the whole paths section
- [Route](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/route.md): route.all and route.byField, overlap, and unrouted rows
- [Passes](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/passes.md): match.sharedRef, match.naturalKey, match.reducedKey and match.groupSum; keys, blocks, conserved fields and the TradeRef veto
- [Limits: search limits](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profiles/limits-search-limits.md): maxGroupSize, maxBlockItems, maxTargetsPerComponent and maxNodesPerTarget
- [Ambiguity in the result](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/results/ambiguity.md): when a pass finds more than one way to match
- [Incomplete search in the result](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/results/incomplete-search.md): BlockTooLarge and BudgetExhausted

## Examples

- [Routing](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profile-examples/routing.md): rows sent to different paths
- [Search limits](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/profile-examples/search-limits.md): a block over the limit, left unresolved
- [Fallback match](https://m-vaysman.github.io/recdiffy.net/docs/reference/readme/10-fallback-match-when-the-reference-is-missing.md): a second pass on fewer fields, with RecBuilder
